evidence: client-access-map-allows-the-listed-ip: postfix_smtp_base_config_file.pp:26 runs /usr/sbin/postmap on the file client_access.erb:2-3 fills with '<ip> OK' per allowed_client_ips; with the fixture's [127.0.0.1], postmap -q 127.0.0.1 on hash:/etc/postfix/client_access must print OK. The mismatch changes only the address it queries (127.0.0.2, not listed), so no entry comes back and the verdict must change

sasl-user-authenticates-through-dovecot: main.cf.erb:92 smtpd_sasl_type = dovecot, and sasl_users.erb:3 writes name:password_hash from smtp_users into /etc/dovecot/users (manifest 117-121), which 10-auth.conf:125 auth-passwdfile reads; doveadm auth test p8testuser with the fixture password must print 'passdb: p8testuser auth succeeded'. The mismatch changes only the password, which dovecot must refuse

starttls-presents-the-sslprefix-bundle: manifest 58 sets certificate_filename to /etc/ssl/certs/<smtp_sslprefix>.postfix.bundle.crt (letsencrypt false), and main.cf.erb:23 makes that file smtpd_tls_cert_file; the probe compares the SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate served over STARTTLS on 587 with /etc/ssl/certs/p8test.postfix.bundle.crt (fixture sslprefix p8test). The mismatch changes only the file it compares against (the first certificate of the CA bundle), so the fingerprints must differ

purpose covered: The purpose matches the manifest header (lines 1-11) and the code. One part is listed differently: the header says the From warning fires when the address IS in the list, while smtp_header_checks.regexp.erb:3 warns when it matches NONE of the regexes; the set follows the code. My reviewer run was ALL_PASS: 10 negatives failed on the clean node, all 10 checks passed after apply, and the 3 mismatches failed. The checks test the class doing its job: smtpd listens on 587 with the configured banner; STARTTLS serves the sslprefix certificate; TLS is mandatory (no AUTH before STARTTLS, 530 for MAIL and AUTH); only dovecot passwd-file users authenticate (a PAM-valid OS account gets 535). Each layer of the restrictions is exercised over real SMTP sessions: each owner sending from its own address, an address outside the general list (554), an address owned by another user (553), no login (553), a wrong password (535), and an unlisted client ::1 (554). A submission is queued and delivered to the local mailbox. A message to another domain is relayed by postfix's SMTP client to a sink on the peer, which receives both messages; the From-header warning is logged for the unlisted From only. Two rows stay uncovered, and both reasons are true. MX resolution: the relay uses an address-literal recipient, and the lab DNS has no fixture zone; lifted_by names the capability of a lab MX zone. extra_sec ciphers, protocols and DH group, plus letsencrypt certificate names: the params fixture leaves extra_sec at its default false and sets letsencrypt false, and phase3.py takes exactly one fixture per set (fixture: params|defaults); lifted_by names the capability of more than one params fixture. Packages and the dovecot service are covered by the behaviour checks above
